the paper gives only an approximate bounding description (~0N,12W to 35N,70E); latitude type assumed planetocentric from the MOLA-based mapping, not stated explicitly in the paper. MOLA tiles use the 0-360 convention, so this region wraps 348-360 deg and 0-70 deg and needs two 128 ppd tiles; the ingestion registry must handle this explicitly.
